mapper.select: SELECT latest.id AS record_id, latest.self_test_id AS self_test_id, q.id AS question_id, q.title AS question_title, st.content AS self_test_content, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(latest.selected_answers, '$[0]')) AS selected_answer, correct_option.option_key AS correct_answer, st.explanation AS explanation, wrong_stats.wrong_count AS wrong_count, latest.create_time AS last_wrong_time FROM question_self_test_record latest INNER JOIN ( SELECT self_test_id, MAX(id) AS latest_record_id FROM question_self_test_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY self_test_id ) latest_group ON latest.id = latest_group.latest_record_id INNER JOIN question_self_test st ON st.id = latest.self_test_id AND st.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN question q ON q.id = st.question_id AND q.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT self_test_id, COUNT(*) AS wrong_count FROM question_self_test_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 0 GROUP BY self_test_id ) wrong_stats ON wrong_stats.self_test_id = latest.self_test_id LEFT JOIN question_self_test_option correct_option ON correct_option.self_test_id = latest.self_test_id AND correct_option.is_correct = 1 WHERE latest.user_id = #{userId} AND latest.is_correct = 0 AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR latest.id < #{cursor}) AND (#{canViewMemberOnly} = 1 OR q.is_member_only = 0) ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
